title: Strain away
text:
Strain away. So there are 2 brands you buy when you are fed up with the crappy cheap kitchen gadgets: kitchenaid or OXO.
This handy strainer is perfect. Super sturdy, quality piece. I've even pressed things in here to get rid of extra liquid, like canned tomatoes. Unlike the others the basket didn't bust and leave me with a mess.

product_metadata.title: KitchenAid KC160OHGSA Stainless Steel Strainer, 5-Inch, Storm Gray
features: This strainer features a 5-inch round shaped head that is perfect for scooping and straining vegetables and noodles
An extended lip and long handle allows this strainer to be securely placed over a bowl for hand-free staining of canned vegetables, beans and more.
The mesh is crafted from durable stainless steel
Dishwasher safe for fast and easy cleanup
One year hassle-free replacement and lifetime limited warranty
description: This Kitchenaid stainless steel mesh strainer is perfect for rinsing and draining various fruits and vegetables, or to scoop and strain foods from liquids. Has a fine stainless steel mesh screen perfect for straining sauces, purees and stocks. Features a lip that will easily slide over pot edges allowing for hands-free straining. The handle is comfortable and easy to hold. Dishwasher safe. Strainer measures 5 inch diameter.
